title: Christian Herter's rule against meeting the mafia without the press

tellings.quote: And he said no one from the mafia could come to talk to me without me inviting the president.

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about Christian Herter, a Massachusetts politician he knew in the 1950s. According to Malmgren, Herter had a rule that no one from the mafia could come to talk to him unless he also invited the press in to watch. Malmgren tells it as an example of how a careful public official guarded himself against hidden influence.
